data.name: Glow-Up or Give Back
data.headline: 57 days to Diwali. Glow up, or we give back.
data.benefit: 57 days to Diwali. We measure you on day 1 and again before the festive photos. Do 30 classes and don't improve? Your third month is on us.
data.rationale: New clients' first 60-day spend averages ₹11,150 at Kwality, ₹8,411 at Bandra and ₹6,747 at Kenkere — under one month's list price. A 2-month bundle doubles it; the 30-class condition makes the guarantee rarely paid.
data.conditions: Standard 15% only; guarantee paid in time.
data.kpi: Bundles sold; day-56 re-test attendance; 3rd-month purchases.

data.benefit: New phone, who dis? It's us — your favourite class. Come back for one free, no-questions-asked class. Buy within 7 days and get 15% off plus an extra freeze.
data.rationale: A free first step lowers the barrier; the 7-day window keeps the decision fast. The freeze has no cash cost.
data.kpi: Comeback classes booked; comeback → purchase within 7 days (target 35%).

data.rationale: October–December are troughs (Kwality Nov-25 ₹18.5L; Bandra Oct-25 ₹10.2L). Locking 3M before the festive season protects the base.

steps.label: W1
steps.text: Set up We Need to Talk in Momence (2027-09-01 to 2027-09-30): Named list — lapsed clients with ≥₹50k lifetime spend (Kenkere ≥₹35k): a call from the studio manager, then 6 Months at 20% (₹90,972 / ₹65,772) or 3 Months at the standard 15% (₹49,177 / ₹35,879), unlimited freezes and a 30-min private to restart.

steps.label: W3
steps.text: Mid-month review against ₹39.6L: by the 15th aim for ~half of 85 new buyers (316 first visits), 93 renewals and 41 winbacks. Push the lists, not a deeper discount.
